stories.title: NFL to review additional allegations against Packers RB Jacobs
stories.summary: The NFL said it will look into additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse by Packers RB Josh Jacobs that were revealed as part of a public records release from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department.

stories.title: Sources: Colts willing to trade Taylor, active in talks with multiple teams
stories.summary: The Colts now are open to trading Jonathan Taylor, sources told ESPN and NFL Network, and multiple teams have reached out to Indianapolis.

stories.title: Jeanie Buss accuses siblings of 'cloak and dagger' tactics in Lakers' family saga
stories.summary: Jeanie Buss accused her siblings of conspiring against her in court filings responding to her siblings' ongoing effort to sell their shares in the Lakers.

stories.title: Coach: Kucherov 'committed' to Lightning despite trade request
stories.summary: Tampa Bay coach Jon Cooper believes star winger Nikita Kucherov wants to remain a part of the Lightning this season despite news of his trade request Friday.

stories.title: LSU lands 5-star center Xavier Young, now has 2027's top class
stories.summary: Five-star center Xavier Young has committed to LSU and plans to reclassify into the 2027 class. The 16-year-old will need to spend at least two years in college before he's eligible for the NBA draft.
